key.name: layout-json
key.description: Stores widget types, sizes, desktop positions, per-widget visibility and target monitor as JSON.

key.name: monitor-index
key.description: Index of the monitor widgets are shown on. -1 uses the primary monitor.

key.name: grid-size
key.description: Snap grid size in pixels used when positioning widgets.

key.name: widget-gap
key.description: Spacing in pixels between widgets and the screen edges.

key.name: snap-to-grid
key.description: Whether widget positions snap to the grid while dragging.

key.name: hide-all
key.description: Hide every desktop widget without removing its configuration.

key.name: edit-mode
key.description: Show edit controls so widgets can be moved and removed.

key.name: widget-opacity
key.description: Opacity of widgets as a percentage (10-100).

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.description: Whether the Desktop Widget icon is shown in the top panel.

key.name: photos-source
key.description: Which source the Photos widget uses: local, immich or mixed.

key.name: photo-interval
key.description: How often the Photos widget switches to another image, in seconds.

key.name: immich-server-url
key.description: Base URL of the Immich server, for example https://immich.example.com.

key.name: immich-api-key
key.description: API key used to authenticate requests to the Immich server.

key.name: immich-scope
key.description: Which Immich photos to use: all, favorites or a specific album.

key.name: immich-album-id
key.description: Identifier of the Immich album to use when the scope is set to album.

key.name: immich-size
key.description: Thumbnail rendition requested from Immich: thumbnail, preview or fullsize.

key.name: calendar-sources
key.description: UIDs of the Evolution Data Server calendar sources shown by the Calendar and Agenda widgets. An empty list uses every enabled calendar.

key.name: bambu-endpoint-url
key.description: Base URL of the self-hosted Bambu bridge, for example https://bambu.example.com.

key.name: bambu-token
key.description: Bearer token sent to the Bambu bridge with every request.

key.name: bambu-refresh
key.description: How often the Bambu widget polls the bridge, in seconds (3-300).

key.name: bambu-notify
key.description: Send a notification when the printer connects or disconnects, and when a print starts, resumes, pauses, finishes or fails.

key.name: bambu-offline-fun
key.description: Show a cute animated mochi face (that reacts to the laptop's temperature, battery and CPU load) instead of a plain "Printer offline" hint when the bridge is reachable but the printer is not.

key.name: bambu-offline-always
key.description: Show the face even when the printer is online or the bridge is unreachable. Useful for testing or as a decoration.

key.name: bambu-face-online
key.description: Show the animated mochi face (instead of the job details) while the printer is online, so it can react to the print state: printing, paused, failed or finished.

key.name: bambu-offline-color
key.description: Hex colour (for example #3584e4) for the offline face, or empty to follow the system accent colour.

key.name: bambu-offline-caption
key.description: Caption shown under the offline face. Leave empty to hide it.

key.name: bambu-hot-temp
key.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius at or above which the offline face looks hot.

key.name: bambu-low-battery
key.description: Battery percentage at or below which the offline face looks sleepy (while not charging).

key.name: bambu-high-load
key.description: CPU load percentage at or above which the offline face looks busy.

key.name: bambu-high-ram
key.description: Memory usage percentage at or above which the offline face looks overloaded (puffing, with a spinning loader and puffs of steam).

key.name: media-show-lyrics
key.description: Fetch time-synced lyrics from LRCLIB and highlight the current line in the Now Playing widget.

key.name: media-lyrics-offset-ms
key.description: Shift the lyric timing by this many milliseconds (negative = earlier, positive = later) to line it up with the audio.

key.name: dev-mode
key.description: Reveal extra testing controls, such as forcing the Bambu face mood, to verify widget behaviour without real-world conditions.

key.name: bambu-dev-mood
key.description: Developer override for the offline face mood: auto, chill, hot, sleepy, charging, busy, overload, printing, paused, error or done. Only applied while developer mode is enabled.

key.name: bambu-dev-cycle
key.description: While developer mode is enabled, rotate through every face mood automatically to preview all animations at once.
